ledger: TECHNICAL_IMPROVEMENT_LEDGER (R379 V2 + R383 ANALYTICAL EQUATION LAYER)
loop: CANDIDATE -> TECHNICAL DIAGNOSIS (limiting variable + direction + R383 QUANTITATIVE margins/sensitivities) -> DETERMINISTIC SOLVE-OR-LLM MUTATION (actual design variable) -> CAD REBUILD -> INDEPENDENT TECHNICAL EVALUATION (monotone + quantitative on the child's OWN measured geometry) -> EVIDENCE/PRIOR-ART RECHECK -> KEEP/KILL (K1-K8) -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT

MAX_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT.justification: the CEO milestone is DIAGNOSE -> TECHNICAL MUTATION -> RE-EVALUATE -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT; two iterations demonstrate repeatability at bounded cost

MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_ITERATION.justification: bounded proposal budget, identical to the R378 epistemic loop: three attempts, then the honest no-defensible-mutation verdict

VALUE_CLASS_STRICTNESS.justification: EXTRACTED claims are span-verified or rejected (Art. II/VI); MODELLED values are admitted only when declared; an unbounded parameter is immutable (ADR_R379 anti-gaming)

mutation_kinds_reserved.ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)
mutation_kinds_reserved.CONTROL_POLICY_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)

keep_criterion: the child's OWN independent technical evaluation must confirm the objective improves in the mutation direction with constraints preserved — a score increase is NEVER sufficient (CEO R379 item 4/8)
outcome_reason: the candidate's own custodied evidence yields no quantifiable technical objective+leverage (admitted: {"parameters": 4, "parameters_with_value": 3, "parameters_extracted": 3, "parameters_modelled": 0, "parameters_with_envelope": 1, "constraints": 1, "objectives": 2, "dependencies": 1, "objects": 6, "failure_modes": 2}); the technical layer cannot engage — an honest measured gap (the 🟡 state), not a kill and not a failure

parameters.name: Nozzle temperature
parameters.value_span: The printer is able to reach 500 °C nozzle

parameters.name: Heated bed temperature
parameters.role: Reduces thermal gradient at part bed interface

parameters.name: Heated chamber temperature
parameters.role: Maintains thermal stability to prevent delamination

parameters.name: Electronics operating temperature range
parameters.value_span: electronics inside operating within the recommended temperature range
parameters.role: Defines safe operating limit for control components

parameters.name: Ambient temperature
parameters.role: External environmental stressor contributing to thermal loss

constraints.justification: Minimum temperature required for stable polycarbonate printing without delamination

objectives.basis: Maintaining the chamber temperature prevents thermal shock and delamination that leads to layer skipping in polycarbonate.
Reaching the high nozzle temperature is necessary to properly melt and extrude polycarbonate material.

failure_modes.name: Layer skipping
failure_modes.problem_link: Result of thermal instability and insufficient melt quality causing extruder starvation or clogging.

failure_modes.name: Delamination
failure_modes.problem_link: Caused by rapid cooling due to low chamber/bed temperatures, leading to part failure.

dependencies.statement: Increasing the heated chamber temperature increases the thermal stress on internal electronics.
Higher chamber temperature reduces the gradient between the part and ambient, mitigating cooling effects.
Increasing nozzle temperature ensures proper melt flow, reducing the likelihood of layer skipping.

objective.basis: Maintaining the chamber temperature prevents thermal shock and delamination that leads to layer skipping in polycarbonate.

uncertainty.note: UNKNOWN values are never treated as zeros; unverifiable constraints are never treated as satisfied (Art. XXV / Art. IV)

conventions.name: ORDINAL_LEVERAGE_BY_PATH_LENGTH
conventions.justification: with MONOTONE-only relations the evaluator cannot rank leverage by magnitude; it ranks by (1) fewest constraint blocks, (2) shortest causal path from the parameter to the objective target, (3) envelope provenance class (EXTRACTED beats MODELLED). This is a declared ordinal convention, not a measurement — recorded on every evaluation that uses it.
conventions.uncertainty: ordinal only; magnitudes are UNKNOWN at this tier

conventions.name: DIRECTIONAL_FAIL_CLOSED
conventions.justification: a proposed change is constraint-BLOCKED when (a) the changed parameter's own numeric constraint would be violated at the proposed value, or (b) a relation-connected constraint target is already VIOLATED or value-UNKNOWN and the predicted direction moves it TOWARD its bound. Fail-closed on directional risk: an unknown-position target moving toward a bound is a blocked move, not an accepted one (Art. IV).

steps: checked 1 constraint(s) numerically where values exist

fidelity_escalation.deciding_question: does a design-variable change improve the objective within constraints, and by how much?
fidelity_escalation.note: the R383 ANALYTICAL_EQUATION tier is LIVE (closed-form deterministic relations with computation logs); the higher tiers (NUMERICAL_SOLVER / SIMULATION / NEURAL_OPERATOR) remain contract-reserved and unregistered; escalation is recorded, never faked at the current tier
